== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ホス：エコー格納庫</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light Side''' — <span lang="ja">ここからの自分の格納庫移動はフォース１を必要とする。</span>

'''Dark Side''' — <span lang="ja">ここからの自分の格納庫移動はフォース２を必要とする。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Hoth: Echo Docking Bay (Dark)]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — Light Side. Your hangar transit from here requires 1 Force. Dark Side. Your hangar transit from here requires 2 Force.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The Japanese title uses エコー格納庫 (Echo hangar). Transit costs of 1 and 2 Force match the English original.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-hothechodockingbay.gif|Original English face]], [[Hoth: Echo Docking Bay (Dark)]].</ref>
